source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
When a model is too large to meet its set-up restrictions:

- During deployment: if its base can’t physically fit entirely inside your deployment zone, place it touching your battlefield edge.
- From **strategic reserves**: if its base can’t fit wholly within the set distance of the edge, place it touching any battlefield edge.
- Disembarking: if it can’t be placed wholly within 3" of the **TRANSPORT** (usually because it measures over 3" in every direction), place it so its base is within 1" of the base or hull of the **TRANSPORT**, while **engaged** with no enemy unit.

In the turn a model is placed touching an edge this way, its unit can’t make a **Normal move**, **Advance move**, **Fall Back move** or **Charge move**, or make ranged attacks; from strategic reserves, this does not apply to **AIRCRAFT** models.

Models such as **AIRCRAFT** whose wings or other parts reach well past their base may overhang the deployment zone or a battlefield edge if they can’t be set up otherwise, but:

- in deployment, the base has to stay entirely inside the deployment zone
- from strategic reserves, they have to be over 8" from every enemy unit
